evidence_policy: Only independently captured real ChatGPT App CDP references may be paired with GPUI captures. Every theme/surface/state is judged independently: a passing sibling cannot rescue a failing state, and a failing sibling cannot suppress a passing state. A ready crop must tightly contain the visible state-local UI; an unmounted or background-dominated region cannot pass. A blocked entry intentionally has no reference/actual fields, so one-sided or synthetic evidence cannot pass the strict audit. As of 2026-08-30 this matrix is a best-effort alignment diagnostic, not a product-visibility switch.
